# Unit IV numbers (generated by `python src/pbl2_unit4.py`; do not edit by hand)

## Part A: HMM over address parts (real data)

- Train: 3688 addresses / 22584 parts; test: 923 / 5778; gold: 60 test addresses / 371 parts (AI-judged, `data/annotation/address_gold.csv`).
- Town list learned from train (13 names, each the part before the state in ≥ 30 train addresses): ammanambakkam, chengalpattu, chennai, gokulapuram, kanchipuram, kattankulathur, kilampakkam, maraimalai nagar, medavakkam, nandivaram-guduvancheri, perumbakkam, tambaram, urappakkam.

### Markov models (held-out log-likelihood per symbol, higher is better)

| model | test ll / symbol |
|---|---|
| order 0 (i.i.d. symbols) | -2.0434 |
| order 1 Markov chain on symbols | -1.3719 |
| HMM, 5 hidden roles (supervised MLE) | -1.4835 |
| HMM after Baum-Welch (from supervised) | -1.3834 |

Stationary distribution of the role chain: PREMISE 0.160, STREET 0.131, AREA 0.213, CITY 0.235, STATE 0.262

### Baum-Welch

- From the supervised start: 106 iterations, train ll -32997.6 → -30741.7 (32.9 s).
- 5 random starts end at train ll -30723.9, -30724.2, -30724.2, -30723.9, -32175.1 (local optima differ).
- Best random start, states mapped to roles by the Hungarian algorithm: state_0→CITY, state_1→STREET, state_2→AREA, state_3→PREMISE, state_4→STATE

### Scaling and sum-product checks

- All 923 test addresses joined = 5778 symbols. Unscaled forward pass returns **0.0**; scaled: log10 p(X) = -4124.2. The unscaled value drops below the smallest float64 after 424 symbols.
- Brute force over 5^7 = 78125 paths for a 7-part address: |Δ log-lik| = 2.31e-14, max |Δ marginal| = 1.63e-14, Viterbi = best path: True.

## Part B: linear dynamical system (SIMULATED trajectory)

**The trajectory is simulated**: the dataset has no movement data. Stops are real pharmacy locations; the agent drives at 25 km/h, sampled every 2 s, with 20 m GPS noise.

- 595 time steps, route length 7.35 km.
- ML (grid over the innovations log-likelihood): GPS σ = 20.5 m (true 20 m), q = 1.78e-07.

| estimate | position RMSE (m) |
|---|---|
| raw_gps | 27.78 |
| moving_average_5 | 12.02 |
| kalman_filter | 15.56 |
| rts_smoother | 8.39 |
